workspaceRef.description: WorkspaceRef is the reference of the Workspace to be started.

config.description: Config is the run-specific configuration of the run being started.

StartWorkspaceRequest.title: Start Workspace Request
StartWorkspaceRequest.description: StartWorkspaceRequest is the request of the StartWorkspace method.

vars.description: Vars is the list of the variables that override the Workspace's own variables for this run.

regionRef.description: RegionRef is the reference of the Region that is chosen to host the run. If it is unset, the Cluster picks a Region on its own, preferring the User's preferred Region if it is set in their UserConfig.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.StartWorksp.title: Config
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.StartWorksp.description: Config is the run-specific configuration that only applies to the run being started.

octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.title: Var
octelium.api.main.cordium.v1.Workspace.S.description: Var is a variable that can be referenced from within the spec's string fields using the `${{ vars.NAME }}` syntax. The substitution is performed after all the configuration levels are merged.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
